name: BaseNative
headline: Apple-grade design, all in code
idea: An open-source design system kit, fully in code: accessible components on real HTML elements, in light and dark, built on web standards.

points.title: Real HTML elements
points.body: Accessible components built on the elements the browser already gives you.

points.title: Light and dark
points.body: Every component, in both themes, out of the box.

points.title: Ready for agents
points.body: AI-safe and ready for agents, built on web standards.
